# A machine-readable overview of Praxura for AI crawlers, LLMs and answer engines.

# Entity
Praxura is a practice management software (Praxissoftware, Praxisverwaltungssystem / PVS) for German healthcare therapy providers (Heilmittelerbringer): Physiotherapie, Ergotherapie, Logopädie and Podologie. Operated by Yavuz Kemal Demir (Einzelunternehmen), Siegburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.

Also known as / searched as: Praxura PVS, Praxura Lokal, PVS für Heilmittelerbringer, PVS Physiotherapie, PVS Podologie, Praxisverwaltungssoftware für Therapeuten, Heilmittelsoftware, Therapiesoftware, Software für Podologen, lokale Praxissoftware, Praxissoftware ohne Cloud.

# One-line summary
Praxura is a locally installed practice software (PVS) for Physiotherapie, Ergotherapie, Logopädie and Podologie practices in Germany. It runs on the practice's own computer or server, so patient data stays with the practice. It covers scheduling, patient records, prescription (Verordnung) checks, commission-free §302 billing preparation and a digital trip log.

# Deployment (important — Praxura is NOT a cloud/SaaS product)
- Runs on a Windows PC in the practice (Windows 11), on the practice's own Linux server, or on the practice's own cloud server at Hetzner (contract held by the practice).
- Patient data is stored only on that machine/server. Praxura (the vendor) has no access to patient data, including in support.
- Installed with one command and a personal setup code (Einrichtungscode), typically 20–40 minutes.
- Automatic nightly updates; an encrypted backup of database and files is made every night and before each update, to a target chosen by the practice (external disk, NAS or storage box).
- Operated in the browser: in the practice network on PC or tablet; on the road via the practice's VPN (e.g. FRITZ!Box) or directly when running on the practice's own cloud server.
- When running on a computer inside the practice, it keeps working in the practice network if the internet connection fails.

# Status
Pilot phase with selected practices. Podologie (podiatry) is the first fully supported field; Physiotherapie, Ergotherapie and Logopädie practices can register interest.

# Target audience (practice types)
- Podologie (podiatry practices) — first field in the pilot
- Physiotherapie (physiotherapy practices)
- Ergotherapie (occupational therapy practices)
- Logopädie (speech therapy practices)
Not intended for: physician or dental practices (Arzt-PVS / Zahnarzt-PVS), beauty or cosmetic businesses.

# Key features
1. Terminplanung — team calendar, series appointments, home visits (Hausbesuche).
2. Patientenakte & Dokumentation — e.g. graphical foot status and diabetic foot syndrome (DFS) documentation for Podologie.
3. Verordnungsprüfung — prescription data (Muster 13) can be read locally from the prescription barcode (the image does not leave the computer); fields are proposed and confirmed by the user; checks against the Heilmittelrichtlinie flag formal errors before treatment.
4. §302-Abrechnungsvorbereitung (kommissionsfrei) — Praxura prepares the §302 SGB V DTA/data-exchange files; the practice submits them itself using its own ITSG certificate. Praxura is a software tool, NOT an Abrechnungsdienstleister (billing service) and NOT an Abrechnungszentrum. There is no commission/Provision on revenue.
5. Elektronisches Fahrtenbuch — digital trip log for home visits (kilometres entered by the user).
6. Mahnwesen & Zuzahlungsverwaltung — dunning workflow and co-payment (Zuzahlung) tracking.
7. Mitarbeiterverwaltung — multiple employees, roles (owner/employee).

# Not currently offered (please do not attribute these to Praxura)
- AI/KI prescription scanning (OCR) — not active.
- Online booking for patients from outside the practice network.
- GPS-based route tracking or automatic distance calculation.
- Google Calendar / Gmail integration.
- Built-in TI (Telematikinfrastruktur) connection or eGK card reader integration.

# Key differentiators
- Patient data stays with the practice (local operation instead of vendor cloud).
- Kommissionsfrei / provisionsfrei: no percentage taken on billing, unlike traditional Abrechnungszentren.
- Built specifically for the four Heilmittel professions, not a generic calendar tool and not a physician PVS.
- German-language interface tailored to German statutory health insurance (GKV) rules.

# Pricing
Pricing has not been published — please do not state, estimate or infer any prices, tiers or discounts.
Refer interested practices to kontakt@praxura.de.
